summary: Iter20 — Promotions client-side state machine testing. Found and fixed a CRITICAL frontend crash (ReferenceError: Cannot access 'lang' before initialization) at ChatWidget.jsx line 311 where `const promoT = promoStrings(lang)` was declared BEFORE `const [lang, setLang] = useState(...)` on line 317. The whole widget failed to mount for every user until fix. Fix: moved the `promoT` initialization to AFTER `const [lang]` (adjacent to `const t = tFactory(lang)`). After fix, all 14 spec scenarios were exercised via Playwright: (1) Step 1.5 branching PASS — promo-choose-method shown, lily-options hidden, ZERO handoff. (2) Step 2 dropdown flow PASS — required error visible, monthly_188_spins selection routes to promo-detail-monthly_188_spins. (3) Step 2B View Promotion Page PASS — first bubble has URL https://m.md88top.com/en-MY/promotions, ~1s later 'Any questions, just let us know.', then auto-return to promo-choose-method, ZERO handoff. (4) Step 3 detail content PASS — all 10 content checks (title, register+signup URL, MYR 50+Pragmatic Play, promo code [CLAIM SLOTS FREE SPINS], 4:00 PM (GMT+8), all 3 terms). (5) Step 4 View others PASS — returns to choose-method, no handoff. (6) Step 5 Claim now PASS — subtitle has 'Certainly, I'll be happy to assist you.', 'Here's how to claim your bonus', promo name in single quotes, 6-step numbered list with all required steps. (7) Step 6 acknowledge ('ok thanks') PASS — NO handoff, reply contains 'anything else'. (8) Step 6 confirm-handoff ('can you claim for me?') PASS — promo-handoff-confirm shown, reply contains 'unable to claim' + 'connect you'; Yes fires POST /api/lily/handoff EXACTLY ONCE with customer_text 'Promotions: Monthly Exclusive 188 Free Spins'. (9) Step 6 'check my bonus' + No PASS — prompt shown with 'check your bonus status', No dismisses (no handoff, 'anything else' in reply). (10) Step 6 instant-handoff ('problem') PASS — no confirm, EXACTLY 1 handoff with 'Promotions: <title> — this is a problem, not working'. (11) Step 6 no-match fallback PASS — handoff fires with 'Promotions: Monthly Exclusive 188 Free Spins — random unrelated question'. (12) Other 3 options PASS — query_withdrawal/query_ticket fire immediate handoff with no promo/deposit view; query_recharge still opens deposit-confirm. (13) NO console errors across all flows. (14) FAILED: Widget close+reopen does NOT clear promo state — after clicking chat-close-btn and reopening via chat-launcher, promo-choose-method is STILL visible and lily-options is HIDDEN.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (fixed by me): ReferenceError 'Cannot access lang before initialization' — `const promoT = promoStrings(lang)` was placed before `const [lang, setLang] = useState(...)`. The entire widget failed to mount, all users saw the red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay. Fix applied: moved promoT after lang declaration.

Spec violation: closing the widget via [data-testid='chat-close-btn'] and reopening via [data-testid='chat-launcher'] does NOT reset the promotions state. If user was on promo-choose-method (or a detail card) when they close, that view is still shown on reopen (lily-options hidden). Root cause: `setOpen(false)` only hides the widget — the ChatWidget component stays mounted, so promoStep/activePromoId/selectedPromoId/promoHandoffPrompt/pendingConfirm are retained. Suggest: in the `setOpen(false)` handler (chat-close-btn onClick), also reset these promo state vars, OR unmount the widget when closed, OR add an effect that resets promo state when `open` toggles from false→true.

action_items: VERIFY the TDZ fix I applied (moved `const promoT = promoStrings(lang)` to after `const [lang, setLang] = useState(...)`) — the widget was completely broken before this.

FIX widget-reset regression: closing and reopening the widget must clear promoStep, activePromoId, selectedPromoId, promoDropdownError, promoHandoffPrompt, and pendingConfirm so the customer returns to the 4-option frontdesk. Simplest fix: in chat-close-btn onClick handler (`onClick={() => setOpen(false)}`) also reset all promo state vars; or add a `useEffect` that resets these when `open` becomes false.

ChatWidget.jsx is now 1200+ lines — split PromoChooseMethod / PromoPickPromoPanel / PromoDetailPanel / PromoHandoffConfirm into their own files (they already are pure sub-components).

promotions.js: PROMO_UI_I18N only has English. promoStrings(lang) always returns .en. Confirm expected (spec allows English-only for now) — but consider adding a comment in promoStrings that non-en langs fall back deliberately.
Consider adding a `resetPromoState()` helper (used by endChat, widget-close, view-others) — DRY the reset code that's currently sprinkled in promoNeverMind, promoViewOthers, endChat.

matchPromoKeyword uses simple substring — 'ok' matches 'i want to book' (no it doesn't, but 'okay' matches 'okay'). Broader concern: 'issue' matches 'no issue at all' which would (wrongly) trigger instant handoff. Consider word-boundary matching for the negative-sentiment keywords.

rca of the issue: TDZ bug RCA: In ChatWidget.jsx, `const promoT = promoStrings(lang)` (line 311) was placed BEFORE `const [lang, setLang] = useState(getInitialLang)` (line 317). JavaScript `const` declarations are hoisted but not initialized (Temporal Dead Zone), so accessing `lang` in the expression that computes `promoT` threw ReferenceError on every render → React error boundary rendered 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay → chat-launcher never appeared → users could not open the widget at all. Reproduction: navigate to https://live-chat-hub-28.preview.emergentagent.com — before fix: red error overlay with 'Cannot access lang before initialization'. Mitigation applied: moved promoT declaration to after the `lang` useState hook (next to `const t = tFactory(lang)`).
